description.value: Hai Phong is a family-owned Vietnamese restaurant on Vancouver's Kingsway corridor, focused on authentic home-style Vietnamese cooking. The Kingsway location is the sole active outpost after the Keefer Street location closed, and it serves a full menu available for dine-in, takeout, and delivery via DoorDash and Uber Eats. A touring cyclist stopping along Kingsway would find a sit-down meal or a quick takeout option in an accessible urban neighbourhood.

bike_parking_detail: 9 racks within 100m: rack at 24m; rack at 40m; rack (3 spaces) at 67m; rack (3 spaces) at 69m; stands (3 spaces, covered) at 76m; stands (4 spaces) at 80m; stands (3 spaces, covered) at 83m; stands (3 spaces, covered) at 88m; wall_loops (3 spaces, covered) at 99m. Total: 22 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the restaurant is actively operating at its Kingsway location with online ordering, DoorDash, and Uber Eats delivery, and the Keefer location is explicitly noted as closed. The website consistently lists the address as 1242 Kingsway, while OSM records 1246 Kingsway — a discrepancy flagged below. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cyclist-specific amenities, so all required criteria remain null except Takeout which is confirmed.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM records 1246 Kingsway; website consistently shows 1242 Kingsway across all pages. Website value used as primary.
OSM has no phone number; phone sourced entirely from website.
No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The restaurant is clearly open and offers takeout, but none of the WWC required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from the website or OSM tags, making it impossible to assess whether it meets the minimum threshold for directory inclusion without a site visit or direct contact.
